bagPolicy.summary: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 14 × 14 × 6 inches and wallet-sized clutches up to 5 × 8 inches are allowed. Medical and parenting bags may be inspected as exceptions.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Two garages west of the center have about 2,100 spaces, with published event parking of $5–$15. Parking has no in-and-out privileges.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The arena A–Z and directions pages do not list a designated rideshare pickup or drop-off point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and beverage services operate inside; outside food and drinks are prohibited. The center is cashless and accepts debit and credit cards.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Elevators are in the north lobby; accessible seating is listed at the tops of Sections 103, 104, 109, 117, 120, 122 and 123.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The re-entry policy varies by event. Check the specific concert’s instructions before leaving.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office faces Gaylord Parkway on the north side and opens two hours before ticketed events, but the venue does not publish one universal will-call pickup procedure.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Entrances are at the northwest and northeast corners of the arena. Doors open about 60 minutes before most events, but the time can vary.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
